optimizedDescription.value: Central entity owning spec-work lifecycle, approvals, artifacts, invalidation, implementation tracking, and append-only history.

optimizedContext.value:
# Change

## Rules

- Identity: immutable unique slug `name`; immutable creation `createdAt`; mandatory event actor `ActorIdentity` with `name`, `email`, optional `provider`, `providerId`, `metadata: Record<string, string>`.
- Revision: persist `updatedAt`; default to `createdAt`; never before `createdAt`; `touchUpdatedAt(at: Date = new Date())` sets/advances it.
- Scope: mutable `specIds`, including empty; validate workspace components at creation. Any `specIds` modification invalidates approvals. `workspaces` computed at runtime from `specIds` via `parseSpecId()`, never declared/persisted; plural touched set, never home/primary workspace or `workspaces[0]` surrogate. `specDependsOn` optional per-spec dependency map, highest-priority `CompileContext` source; updates do not invalidate. `updateSpecIds()` prunes keys absent from new `specIds`. `CompileContext` dynamically reads `.specd-metadata.yaml` for remaining dependencies and resolves transitively each execution.
- Lifecycle: `drafting → designing → ready → implementing ⇄ verifying → done → archivable → archiving`; with `approvals.spec: true`, route `ready → pending-spec-approval → spec-approved → implementing`; with `approvals.signoff: true`, route `done → pending-signoff → signed-off → archivable`. Both gates default `false`; gated states otherwise unreachable. Valid transitions live in `VALID_TRANSITIONS`; every non-`drafting` state may return to `designing`. `designing → designing` neither invalidates nor downgrades.
- From `archiving`, only `archivable` and `designing` valid; others throw `InvalidStateTransitionError`. Commit failure + successful batch canonical restore may yield `archivable`; restore failure leaves `archiving`, with manual `designing` escape. Pre-commit failure leaves `archivable`.
- `implementing → verifying` requires all task items complete through workflow `taskCompletionCheck`. `implementation-failure` returns `verifying → implementing` without invalidation/downgrade; reset only artifacts in `implementing.requires`. `artifact-review-required` returns to `designing`. Loop unbounded; history records rounds. Artifact drift independently invalidates to `designing`.
- Implementation state remains separate from artifacts: `trackedImplementationFiles` use project-relative paths and states `open|resolved|ignored|removed`; `removed` persists, cannot resolve directly, returns `open` only after refresh proves existence. `implementationLinks` support `spec -> file` and `spec -> file -> symbols`; active paths stay project-relative until archive normalization. Preserve explicit file-level presence versus container-only presence: removing final symbol preserves explicit link but may remove container-only set.
- Historical implementation signal is any past `transitioned.to === implementing`; once true, remains true and gates demand-driven detection plus draft/discard safeguards. `Change` exposes signal but performs no detection.
- Spec approval records approver identity, reason, artifact hashes. Signoff always gates all change content when enabled. Archive allowed only from `archivable`; otherwise `InvalidStateTransitionError`.
- Artifacts: `ChangeArtifact` contains `type`, `optional`, ordered `requires`, persisted aggregate `state`, `files: Map<string, ArtifactFile>`. `scope: change` typically one type-keyed file; `scope: spec` one per `specIds`. `ArtifactFile` contains `key`, `filename`, explicit persisted `state`, `validatedHash`, `hasDrift`; `validatedHash` uses schema `preHashCleanup`, and `"__skipped__"` marks explicitly skipped optional output.
- Canonical file/artifact states: `missing|in-progress|complete|skipped|pending-review|drifted-pending-review`; explicit file state plus presence is authoritative, never `validatedHash` alone. Aggregate priority: any drifted → `drifted-pending-review`; else any pending → `pending-review`; all complete/skipped with files → `complete`; all skipped → `skipped`; all missing/no files → `missing`; otherwise `in-progress`. `pending-parent-artifact-review` means recursive upstream DAG dependency review blocks file; aggregate applies when no drift/pending and at least one parent-blocked file.
- Only optional artifacts may be `skipped`; actor must set explicitly. `ChangeArtifact.markComplete(key, hash)` delegates to file, updates baseline/state, recomputes aggregate; callable only via `ValidateArtifacts`. `ChangeArtifact.markSkipped()` marks all files; callable only via skip use case. Only `complete|skipped` satisfy `requires`.
- Return to `designing` reopens validated files per invalidation policy; drifted files retain drift meaning. Scope change while already `designing` still reopens prior validation. `syncArtifacts(artifactTypes)` reconciles schema types/files and returns changed boolean; changes append `artifacts-synced` with `SYSTEM_ACTOR` (`{ name: specd, email: system@getspecd.dev, provider: system }`).
- History append-only; events never modified/removed. State equals latest `transitioned.to`, else `drafting`; active/draft status equals latest `drafted`/`restored`; active gate approval is latest approval not followed by `invalidated`. Events: `created`, `transitioned`, `spec-approved`, `signed-off`, `invalidated`, `drafted`, `restored`, `artifact-skipped`, `artifacts-synced`, `description-updated`, `discarded`, `archive-failed`; every event has `type`, ISO 8601 `at`, mandatory `by`.
- `invalidated` carries machine cause `spec-change|artifact-drift|artifact-review-required|spec-overlap-conflict`, human `message`, full deduplicated `affectedArtifacts` entries (`type`, file `files`). Multiple drifted files share one event. Overlap conflict message names archived change and overlapping specs; append rollback `transitioned` to `designing`.
- `archive-failed` records `step: prepare|commit|archive`, human `message`, `commitStarted`. Commit-phase failure attempts batch restore; successful restore transitions `archiving → archivable`, failure stays `archiving`. Successful archive adds no new active-change success event; archived record owns success traceability. Post-move metadata/hook failures do not undo completion.
- `created` records `schemaName`/`schemaVersion`. Schema name mismatch throws `SchemaMismatchError` before work. Same-name version mismatch warns only; change remains usable and archivable.
- Draft moves `changes/ → drafts/`, appends `drafted`, preserves lifecycle; restore uses `RestoreChange` + `ChangeRepository.mutateDraft`, appends `restored`; discard moves active/draft to `discarded/`, appends `discarded`, requires reason + actor, may record `supersededBy`, irreversible. After any historical `implementing`, draft/discard require explicit force.
- Drafted changes are read-only outside restore/discard through `mutateDraft`: no transitions, validation, scope edits, approvals, invalidation, implementation updates, or artifact writes. Inspect through `ChangeRepository.getDraft`/`GetDraft` as `DraftedChangeView`; active lookup returns null. Invalid mutation yields `ChangeNotFoundError` or `DraftedChangeReadOnlyError`.
- `Change.invalidate()` requires cause, human message, focused `affectedArtifacts`, `artifactDag: ArtifactDag`; optional `invalidationPolicyOverride` supersedes persisted policy. Always append `invalidated`; if outside `designing`, transition there. `none`: reopen none; `surgical`: normalized targets; `downstream`: targets + `artifactDag.descendantsOf()`; `global`: all. Deduplicate targets; never derive DAG from persisted `requires` or private BFS.
- `hasDrift` persists per file and means current content/presence differs from validated baseline. Only `artifact-drift` sets it, only on focused files. Manual `artifact-review-required` neither sets nor clears it. `complete` + drift may render `complete-with-drift`; absent file remains canonical `missing` even with drift.
- `LifecycleEngine`, not `Change`, owns schema-DAG dependency interpretation, recursive blockers, approval routing, step reachability, and effective artifact status. `Change` owns persisted facts only.

## Constraints

- `name`/`createdAt` immutable; `updatedAt >= createdAt`.
- `workspaces` derived, plural, non-persisted; empty `specIds` valid; never infer primary workspace.
- Lifecycle state/history authoritative; no state snapshot; history immutable.
- Artifact state explicit; `validatedHash` baseline only; `hasDrift` independent persisted signal.
- Reopening policy-driven; `skipped` optional-only and dependency-satisfying.
- `ChangeArtifact.markComplete(key, hash)` only `ValidateArtifacts`; `ChangeArtifact.markSkipped()` only skip use case.
- `verifying → implementing` never invalidates approvals; only implementation-required artifacts reset.
- Archive only from `archivable`; both approval gates opt-in.
- Draft/discard after implementation require force; discard requires reason/by and cannot be restored.
- Effective artifact/blocker/workflow interpretation belongs exclusively to `LifecycleEngine`.
